### Changed

- Align files according to platform standards in [#2844](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2844) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot])
- *(deps)* Update actions/setup-node action to v7.1.0 in [#2813](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2813) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- *(deps)* Update dependency @lezer/common to v1.5.3 in [#2846](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2846) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])

### Fixed

- *(agent-platform)* Key a streamed artifact by its id so the latest reply does not show twice in [#2827](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2827) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(plans-backend)* Cache /content per person, ref and path for 60 s in [#2849](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2849) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(agent-platform)* Let a streamed item advance its polled copy instead of being dropped in [#2847](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2847) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
